ios.desc:
Get the party started with the number one social guessing game!

Charades is the ultimate multiplayer guessing game designed to bring people together. Whether you need a quick icebreaker for a night out, a fun activity for a family gathering, or a competitive group game for a party, this is the app for you. Put your acting skills, pantomime talents, and trivia knowledge to the ultimate test!

Heads up! This is the classic headbands style game where you place the phone on your forehead and guess the word. With thousands of cards across dozens of categories, including Netflix favorites and Harry Potter magic, the fun is endless. You can even create your own custom decks to make your next event truly unique.

Why Charades is the top choice for parties:
• Ultimate Party Games: Perfect for large groups, couples, or small teams.

• Massive Content Library: Play through thousands of unique cards across a wide variety of decks.

• Act it out & Mimic: Improve your communication and creativity through hilarious pantomime and gestures.

• Social Trivia & Quiz: Test your knowledge on pop culture, history, and modern trends.

• Multiplayer Fun: Play with two people or a hundred. It is the best social game for any crowd.

• No Internet Games: Our app works perfectly offline. It is the ideal no internet game for road trips, flights, and camping.

• Custom Decks: Create and save your own cards for inside jokes or specific events.

How to Play: Fast and Simple
Getting started with this headbands style game is fast and easy. It is the perfect offline game for any social setting:

1. Select a Category: Choose a deck that fits your group's vibe.

2. The Forehead Challenge: Heads up! One player lifts the device to their forehead. The countdown begins!

3. Act and Describe: Friends will use gestures, dances, and clues to describe the word on the screen.

4. Tilt to Score:
    - Tilt down if you guess correctly to earn a point!
    - Tilt up to pass and skip to the next word.

5. Beat the Clock: Get as many correct guesses as possible before time runs out!

Discover our Diverse Categories:
Our library is organized so you can find exactly what you need. Our decks cover everything from classic acting to the biggest trends of 2026:

• Pop Culture & Media: Blockbuster Movies, TV Shows, Netflix, Anime, K-pop, and Streamers.
• Special Interests: Harry Potter, Super Heroes, Soccer Legends, NBA Stars, and Internet Memes.
• Gaming & Tech: Video Games, Pokémon, Programming, and Crypto.
•

quotes.text:
I built a Charades-game [1] for both iOS [2] and Android [3]. Launched last year and just recently got to around 2k a month, some months like December are of course better than let's say September because of holidays like New Year etc.

It took about 10-12 months reaching those numbers, and I'd say we still have lot's of room for improvement. It's also very low maintenance, but highly scalable. What I do is basically localise the game to as many big languages as I can, and then throw some ASO on it and hold my fingers. Haven't spent any dollars at all on the marketing otherwise.

[1] https://yangmeistudios.com/games-and-apps/charades
[2] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/charades-what-am-i/id1592118437
[3] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yangmeistudios.charades
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Side project of more than $2k monthly revenue? what's your project?
